name: B10-0418/2026 (PPE) – Post-electoral repression in Zambia and the killing of Mutotwe Kafwaya
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the post-electoral repression in Zambia and the killing of Mutotwe Kafwaya
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position on Zambia's August 2026 elections and the death of opposition figure Mutotwe Kafwaya, shot during a security raid in Lusaka. It asks Zambia's authorities to show clear evidence for treason charges against opposition candidate Brian Mundubile and his running mate, give them a fair trial, and run an independent, transparent investigation into the raid. It also urges Zambia to investigate election-counting problems and restore public trust.

- No law changes; the Parliament only states its position and makes requests to Zambia.
- It concerns Zambia's government, its opposition leaders and the EU's partnership with the country.
- Next, the text goes to EU institutions and Zambia's government and parliament; no vote result is given here.
